properties.name: optionsBinder
properties.label: Options Binder
properties.description: The records whose values and words are drawn, as the Options Value Formatter takes its binder

properties.name: options
properties.label: Further values
properties.description: Values the binder's records hold no row for, with their words. A record that holds the value keeps its own words.

properties.name: split
properties.label: Split on ;
properties.description: True: a stored value is cut on ; and each part worded, then joined with a comma and a space (', ', as the Options Value Formatter does). False: the stored value is worded whole.

properties.name: unlisted
properties.label: A value with no words
properties.description: A value that neither the binder nor the grid holds is shown exactly as stored.
